subtitle: Correct risk behavior loses by 2 HP from second seat
synopsis: This is the cautionary replay. FlashLite-S3-RISK follows its risk-band policy and still loses to GPT4oMini-S0-AO by 2 HP. GPT4oMini went first and gained just enough tempo to survive. The match explains why the VariableDamage cross-tier headline needs a caveat: good scaffolding improved behavior, but seat effects and stochastic damage still shaped the outcome.
